subject: Shadow account discovery & SCIM artifact request
messages:
From: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@medicareplus.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: audits@auditdock.co
Date: 2025-12-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Shadow accounts discovery + SCIM artifacts request

Hi Jonas —

Quick one as we prep for our SOC 2 readiness window next quarter. AuditDock asked us to produce a short package showing:

- SCIM delta for the last 90 days (user create/update/delete with timestamps)
- Full service-account inventory (names, owners, last-activity timestamp)
- SAML assertion samples for a handful of Okta-authenticated sessions (for assertion format & attributes)
- A short note on our RBAC/role pruning policy and any accounts with elevated/delegated admin privileges

Can Redwood deliver these artifacts as attachments and a short mapping of which service accounts are "non-human" vs "human-managed"? Target deadline is COB next Tuesday (2025-12-16). Also please flag any accounts with no activity > 120 days — auditor wants to see an action plan for stale principals.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Rajiv
Compliance Manager, MedicarePlus

(Attachment request: CSV export preferred; if files are too large, a Drive link works.)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@medicareplus.com>
Cc: audits@auditdock.co, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2025-12-14T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Shadow accounts discovery + SCIM artifacts request

Hi Rajiv —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the package and hit your Tuesday deadline. Plan:

1) I will export a SCIM delta CSV containing user id, username/email, event (create/update/delete), timestamp, and source (Okta/SCIM API).
2) Laura will pull a service-account inventory with columns: principal id, display name, owner (email), role(s), last auth timestamp, and whether the principal is human/non-human.
3) We will assemble three anonymized SAML assertion samples and a short note describing the SAML attributes we include (email, groups, role).
4) We will run a quick activity sweep and flag principals with last_activity > 120 days. For each flagged principal we will include the owner and a recommended remediation (disable/rotate/reassign).

Two quick clarifications:
- Do you want delegated-admin roles included in the inventory (they can be noisy)? My recommendation is to include them but mark them as delegated and call out how delegation is granted.
- For the SAML samples, do you need raw encoded assertions, or is a decoded/annotated text file sufficient for AuditDock?

I will circulate the artifacts as attachments and provide a Drive link if any file exceeds 10MB.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Security Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

(Attachment stubs to follow: scim_delta.csv, service-account-inventory.xlsx, saml_assertion_samples.txt)

On Sun, Dec 14, 2025 at 09:12 AM Rajiv Shah <rajiv@medicareplus.com> wrote:
> Can Redwood deliver these artifacts as attachments and a short mapping of which service accounts are "non-human" vs "human-managed"?

I can own the quick activity sweep and the "stale principal" tagging. Laura — can you pull the service-account list from the inventory API and mark the owner column? I'll run the last-auth query and produce a filtered sheet with >120d and >365d buckets.

Also recommend we include a short paragraph describing our SCIM sync cadence and any known delays (we had a window where delta processing lagged for ~2 hours in Oct; call that out). Auditors like context.

I'll prep the remediation suggestions (disable vs rotate) for each flagged account so Rajiv has an action plan.

Hannah
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

P.S. Laura — once you attach the files, I'll run a quick sanity check and spam-scan the CSV for any PII before we send externally.
